instruction.name: vavg.du
instruction.description: Compute the average (rounded towards negative infinity) of corresponding unsigned 64-bit elements in `a` and `b`, save the result in `dst`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
